content.push(localize('sessionsChat.sessionFilters', "The Environment, Created In, and Harness submenus filter the Sessions list. Checked options are included. On This Computer and remote hosts, applications other than VS Code are hidden by default. Slack and Teams applications in Cloud are also hidden by default. Show Done, or Show Archived depending on your settings, includes archived sessions. Reset Filters restores these defaults and shows an Undo notice at the bottom of the Sessions list that restores your previous filters. On desktop, Compact View and Collapse All Groups are available from the Sessions More Actions menu. On phone, use Sort and Find to navigate the list."));

content.push(localize('sessionsChat.sessionCreationFilters', "Created In lists the applications that created sessions, grouped by This Computer, Cloud, and each remote host, with the environment in each application's name. VS Code is always offered for each available environment, even before you create a session there. Other applications are listed after a session created in them is discovered. Only applications from included environments are listed. Excluding an environment hides its applications without changing their selections; including it again restores them. Other list filters do not remove application choices. Included remote hosts retain their applications while cached sessions remain, even when disconnected. If no environments are included, select an environment first."));

Delete Group also deletes the group's subgroups; when it deletes more than one group, an Undo notice appears at the bottom of the Sessions list that restores them.
